question: Which active fix path should be treated as canonical for #99241 before ClawSweeper queues or closes any additional work?
rationale: Two open PRs overlap the same user-visible failure, and one is maintainer-labeled with a known review blocker; choosing the canonical path is a maintainer review decision, not a safe new automation job.

options.title: Use #100795 as canonical
